Unproven supply/booking/coverage is a fulfillment evidence or commitment gate, not an invented additional policy prohibition. Human review does not waive any hard constraint.

Pricing.rationale: Revenue = 4 × EUR 1,898.80 = EUR 7,595.20; list total EUR 8,080.00; cost = 4 × EUR 1,656.40 = EUR 6,625.60. Discount = (list−quote)/list = 6.000000%; gross margin = (quote−standard cost)/quote = 12.765957%. One line means these also are the list-weighted deal discount and revenue-weighted deal margin. Category floor 8% is tested per line. Margin clears its floor; discount is within the 35% hard cap and does not trigger >10% or >20% sales-discount escalation.
